text.description_html:
First Impressions SNJ2015FRDSST, Hand Forged San Juan Door Pull

Fit for a castle, the San Juan Pull with Diamond Mounts makes a bold impression that is suited well for old world style homes. This hand forged pull is 15-3/4 inches long with 9-11/16 inch mounting centers. They are great for rustic barn door handles. Choose from matte black or dark brown lithonia finishes.

Surface Mounting: Pull screws to the face of the door. Standard for 1-1/4" or thicker wood, composite or metal doors.

Specifications for the First Impressions SNJ2015FRDSST 15-3/4 Inch San Juan Handle:

  • Total Length: 15-3/4"
  • Mounting Centers: 9-11/16"
  • Projection: 4-1/2"
  • First Impressions SNJ2015FRDSST Dimensions Diagram (PDF)

Note: This door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Cancelable or Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Sold individually (1 door pull handle).
